catalyst.why: The report must show a miss or margin pressure from oil costs and deferred repairs, confirming estimates are too high.

reasons: All 2 EPS revisions in the last 30 days were cuts, with none upward, yet AZO still trades at 18.95x forward earnings; the estimate cuts are not priced in.
Group III base oil supply disruption from Middle East conflict raises AutoZone's lubricant costs, squeezing gross margin even as the company's last quarter showed 13.3% revenue growth.
Consumers are deferring non-critical repairs as repair prices jumped at a record monthly rate in August 2025, shifting AutoZone's sales mix away from high-margin hard parts.
